verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a cloud-synced password manager, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any region or residency selection for Proton Pass data. The pack only covers adjacent topics such as encryption, export, offline access and the CLI, which earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
